title: AI-Assisted chemical probe discovery for the understudied Calcium-Calmodulin Dependent Kinase, PNCK.
summary: The naive-Bayes campaign selected purchased compounds; a cell-free kinase assay found six hits and one lead scaffold. Other scaffolds arose from shape screening, so they are not attributed to ML.
organization: University of Miami; Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center

evidence.tested: The naive-Bayes campaign selected purchased compounds; a cell-free kinase assay found six hits and one lead scaffold. Other scaffolds arose from shape screening, so they are not attributed to ML.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Laplacian-modified naive Bayes kinase classifiers is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
